title: KITH_BIND_ADDR not in Config struct, undocumented, wrong prefix
description: In main.rs line 154, the fallback plain-HTTP bind address is read via std::env::var("KITH_BIND_ADDR") directly in main(), bypassing Config entirely. Problems: (1) It uses a KITH_* prefix while all other kithd vars use KITHD_*; a maintainer doing 'grep KITHD_' in the codebase will miss it. (2) It is not in the Config struct, so there is no central list of supported env vars. (3) The value is passed to TcpListener::bind() without validation — a malformed address panics at unwrap_or_else(exit), which is acceptable, but the error message does not tell the operator what value was rejected. Fix: move KITH_BIND_ADDR into Config as fallback_bind_addr, rename it to KITHD_FALLBACK_ADDR, document it in the struct.
